scope: Nonmutating HATCH/MPOLYGON OCS boundary-point conversion when adding the HATCH elevation to a finite boundary-point Z overflows before rotation.

finding.priorBehavior: The OCS boundary Z and entity elevation were added directly. That intermediate can overflow even when the orthogonal OCS-to-WCS rotation distributes the exact finite inputs into three representable WCS components.
finding.change: When the direct elevation-plus-boundary-Z sum is non-finite, use a scaled, compensated four-term dot product that applies the OCS rotation to the two Z contributions separately. If the stable calculation cannot produce a finite result, retain the prior non-finite result behavior.
finding.scopeBoundary: Ordinary finite elevation sums retain the existing arithmetic path. This is arithmetic robustness for the public coordinate helper, not a change to stored HATCH/MPOLYGON data, parsing, native rendering, or producer qualification.

generatedControls: Positive elevation and boundary Z each equal 0.6 * DBL_MAX; their direct sum overflows, while the rotated normal (1,1,1) yields three finite components matching 1.2 * DBL_MAX / sqrt(3).
Negative elevation and boundary Z each equal -0.6 * DBL_MAX; their direct sum overflows negatively, while the rotated result remains finite and matches the analytic components.
Existing ordinary arbitrary-normal point/vector mapping and large-coordinate intermediate-cancellation controls remain in the same focused selector.
unresolved: Exact real-number arithmetic is not provided; generated results are checked within floating-point tolerance.
Native CAD rendering, external producer behavior, broad OCS conversion coverage, and support claims remain unqualified.
claimEffect: Closes only the generated finite-result overflow case for HATCH/MPOLYGON boundary-point coordinate conversion. No DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
